# Nonlinear approach to benchmark index tracking

A concept shared by **2** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #3,673. ## Description

Proposed nonlinear approach to benchmark index tracking: Choose portfolio weights to track a target index while controlling tracking error, turnover, liquidity constraints, and transaction costs; this is an allocation objective, not inherently a return-prediction edge. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
